decisions.finding_quote: Where reductions did appear, ... they trace to one of two causes:
decisions.reason: In labels_screening_blind.json, the blind labellers marked only the 3 DEPTH-01 (CTV-C9C374) answers defensible and the other 9 not defensible. That includes both CHART-01-ADAPTER runs and DEFINER-01, where the reasons say tests or documentation pin the convention. MASK-01 run-003 (MASK_PLACEMENT_ATTRIBUTION) is neither an entry-point ranking nor an ambiguous-gold case. PROMISING_MECHANISMS.md lists MASK-01 and CHART-01-ADAPTER under 'Reductions that neither judgement explains as ambiguity'. The coordinator's labels (labels_S1.json) do rate CHART-01 'yes', so the edit reports both readings. This edit replaces the whole paragraph and also fixes the Phase 4 wording and the 'all in screening' wording.

edits.old:
**Where reductions did appear,** all in screening and all in instances tuned against Claude in earlier work, they trace to one
of two causes:

- **a second defensible fault location:** a decoy whose own documentation contradicts its code, a correct sibling that permits
  an alternative repair, or an unstated convention;
- **proximity ranking** of the method the test calls, which appeared only when such an alternative repair was available or the
  helper chain was long.

Phase 4 diagnostics removed exactly those features, and the two 0/3 instances became 3/3. GPT-5.6 found and read the gold in
every wrong answered run. Its errors were ranking and attribution decisions, never search failures.
edits.new:
**Where wrong rankings did appear,** all in screening (12 S1 misses) and all in instances tuned against Claude in earlier work,
most fit one of two patterns:

- **a second defensible fault location:** the blind labellers judged only the 3 DEPTH-01 answers defensible, where the decoy's
  own documentation contradicts its code. The coordinator's validity review also flagged a correct sibling that permits an
  alternative repair (COMPRESS-07) and an under-specified convention (CHART-01-ADAPTER), but the blind labellers judged those
  answers not defensible;
- **proximity ranking** of the method the test calls (5 runs), which appeared only when a correct sibling offered an
  alternative repair (COMPRESS-07) or the helper chain was long (MASK-01, CF-V1).

Not every miss fits these patterns. In ADV-MASK-01 run 3 the agent blamed a decoy although both judgements found the gold
better supported, and on the blind reading the CHART-01-ADAPTER and DEFINER-01 misses went against conventions pinned by tests
or documentation in the repository.

In exploratory Phase 4 revisions (n = 3 each), the two 0/3 instances became 3/3: COMPRESS-07 after the correct sibling and its
test were removed, and DEPTH-01 after two javadoc edits (the decoy's contradiction removed and the gold's contract pinned), so
which DEPTH-01 edit mattered is not identified. GPT-5.6 found and read the gold in every wrong answered run. Its errors were
ranking and attribution decisions, never search failures.
